kaapa-ethanol-commodities.story: As of Oct 17, the AGSIST network reads cash bids at 4 KAAPA Ethanol Commodities locations, all in Nebraska. The towns on the list are Aurora, Elm Creek, Minden and Ravenna. The table carries corn and soybeans, and the page gets rebuilt through the day as those bids move.

kanza-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 17 Kanza Cooperative locations, and all 17 are in Kansas. The towns include Andale, Byers, Cheney, Coats, Colwich and Garden Plain. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot that posts them.

keystone-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 4 Keystone Cooperative locations, all of them in Indiana. The towns include Columbia City, Hamilton, Holland and Union Mills. The table carries bids for corn and soybeans at each one.

kokomo-grain-co.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 8 Kokomo Grain Co. locations, all of them in Indiana. Towns on the list include Amboy, Anderson, Edinburgh, Frankfort, Kokomo and Lafayette. The table carries corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.
